facts.fact: The June 2023 terms of reference plan a pilot GIS-based revenue collection database and a digital payment system in two city corporations, Monrovia and Paynesville, within a 36-month advisor contract; it describes no local government as recording on such a system yet.
facts.system: LURP GIS revenue collection database and digital payment system (planned)

facts.fact: The advisor and the pilot revenue database are financed by the World Bank under the Liberia Urban Resilience Project (IDA-7112-LR and E0410-LR), run through the Ministry of Public Works; the dataset is to be owned by the municipalities.
facts.system: LURP GIS revenue collection database and digital payment system (planned)

facts.fact: The terms of reference put the advisor under the Project Management Unit of the Ministry of Public Works, a central ministry, while the data collected is to be owned by the municipalities and the Republic of Liberia.
facts.system: LURP GIS revenue collection database and digital payment system (planned)
